texts: good. the feather store is one thing held at the Watch, "the Watch" stays an ordinary capitalized common noun rather than being treated as a name, and "large" is recorded straight on the store.

good. "Sunken Cove" is bound by its name, its lanterns bind as a group belonging to it, and the open "what happens" is asked with those lanterns as the place and winter as the time. Word the answering facts the same way — "the Sunken Cove lanterns" as a group — so question and fact line up.
